subject: Order form dependencies & weekly bridge plan
messages:
From: Emily Ramos <emily@solsticetherapeutics.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Solstice Procurement <procurement@solsticetherapeutics.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Order form dependencies & weekly bridge plan

Hi David / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looks like a strong fit for our use case. Procurement here at Solstice is trying to map a compressed close timeline (target: 2 weeks) for the MSA/DPA + order form so we can hit an Aug 1st kickoff. To be realistic, can you confirm: 

- The required legal artifacts you need us to review/approve (MSA, DPA, order form).
- Any dependencies that typically block signature (SOC2, specific security evidence, PO format, export controls).
- A suggested milestone schedule (legal review windows + procurement sign-off + signature).

If you can send a brief mutual action plan and a single-sheet timeline we can circulate internally, that would help — procurement needs to show the execs a clear two-week path. We have internal review on Thursday morning (Jul 8) and can commit to a 48-hour review once we receive final redlines.

Are you available for a 30-min alignment call on Jul 8 at 10am PT? If you prefer, send the MAP and we’ll take the doc review route.

Thanks,
Emily Ramos
Head of Procurement
Solstice Therapeutics

P.S. Our billing team prefers an invoice addressed to Solstice Therapeutics, Attn: Accounts Payable. I can share AP contact details on the call.

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ramos <emily@solsticetherapeutics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form dependencies & weekly bridge plan

Emily — thanks, this is helpful. Attaching a condensed MAP (MAP_week1-3.xlsx) and a working order form draft (OrderForm_Draft.docx). Also attaching our current redlines to the MSA (MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) so you can see the items legal typically focuses on.

High-level proposal (two-week compressed path):

Week 0 (today — your internal review on Jul 8)
- Send MSA+DPA redlines + order form draft (attached).
- Solstice does 48-hour initial pass on non-negotiable items (pricing, invoicing, data retention).

Week 1 (Jul 12–16) — Legal deep review
- Laura/Redwood legal to produce MSA_redlines_v4 by EOD Jul 13.
- SOC2/attestations and DPA appendix reviewed in parallel.

Week 2 (Jul 19–23) — Commercial closure & signature window
- Final order form and pricing agreed; DocuSign package sent by Jul 20.
- Target signature by Jul 23; implementation kickoff week of Jul 26.

Key dependencies to call out:
- Evidence: SOC2 report + data retention and deletion procedures (we can provide SOC2 link and the DPA appendix).
- Billing: confirm AP contact and PO/invoice requirements (number format, remittance address).
- Export/control clauses: if you have restricted data classifications, flag them now.

Laura — I've looped you for the redline cadence noted above. Karthik — can you confirm the pricing tier and whether there’s room for a one-time onboarding credit (this impacts Solstice exec sign-off). Neha — heads-up that success will need a 2-week implementation window after signature; can you scope the kickoff?

If the two-week path is too aggressive, tell me where you want to lengthen the window and we’ll adjust the MAP. If Jul 8 call still works, I’ll take it.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_week1-3.xlsx; OrderForm_Draft.docx; MSA_redlines_v3.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form dependencies & weekly bridge plan

David — quick internal note on MSA redlines (replying inline to your send):

> Attaching our current redlines to the MSA (MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) so you can see the items legal typically focuses on.

Key items we should address before sending to Solstice for final review:
- Limit of liability: propose cap = 12 months of fees (current redline shows 6, counter-propose to 12).
- DPA appendix: we need a clear data sub-processing list and deletion window (30 days post-contract or earlier if requested).
- Warranty & uptime SLA: we should preserve standard SLA with credits; avoid unlimited remedies.
- Export control clause: standard carve for regulated data; ask Solstice for classification.
- Indemnity: tighten language around third-party claims to exclude customer’s own negligence.

I’ll produce MSA_redlines_v4 by end of day Jul 13 as proposed. For Solstice: if procurement can confirm SOC2 link and AP contact (as Emily mentioned), that will unblock a lot.

Karthik — once I hand off v4 I’d like commercial to confirm price tier within 24 hours so we can avoid back-and-forth.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

3) Let us know if you need an alternate invoice/payee name or any special tax paperwork.
